(async()=>{const f=new File([new Uint8Array([37,80,68,70])],'probe.pdf',{type:'application/pdf'});const can=navigator.canShare({files:[f]});let r='not attempted';try{const p=navigator.share({files:[f],title:'probe'});r=await Promise.race([p.then(()=>'resolved',e=>'rejected: '+e.name+' '+e.message),new Promise(res=>setTimeout(()=>res('pending after 4s'),4000))])}catch(e){r='threw: '+e.name+' '+e.message}return JSON.stringify({canShareFiles:can,result:r,activation:navigator.userActivation&&navigator.userActivation.isActive})})()
